                      Integers as Bytes: Properties

Abstract

   This text is a test fixture for vector's byte-order operations, laid
   out as an RFC's plain text so that vector reads it.  It is not an
   RFC.

1.  Writing

   An integer written as bytes MUST be written as its two's complement,
   in the byte order the operation names.

2.  Reading

   Bytes read as an integer MUST be read in the byte order the
   operation names, as exactly as many bytes as the integer's width.
